channel.title: The Deadliest Cure
channel.description: A 25-episode audio series on tuberculosis: its history, science and why a curable disease is still the world's deadliest infection. Structure follows the chapters of John Green's Everything Is Tuberculosis; scripts are original. Guests are fictional composites. Personal listening feed.
